summary: The PR addresses the issue of not clearing model options during the squashing of migrations but introduces some style inconsistencies and could benefit from clearer documentation.

issues.description: The new test files use print statements for output instead of assertions, which is not idiomatic for test files. It would be better to use assertions to verify the expected outcomes.
The code change lacks comments explaining why the options are being updated in this specific way, which could help future maintainers understand the logic.
